thread:
priya: Heads-up — planning a split-phase rollout for engine-quant matmul-slim v3 tonight during the quiet window (00:30-03:00 UTC). Want to stage in 3 waves and keep a strict rollback gate.

alex: +1. what are the canary targets and regions?

priya: canary 2% in us-east-1, then 10% in eu-west-1, then 100% global. will pin any failing infra.

zach: please add thermal/oom watch and model-variant fallback in the canary buckets. last time we saw p95 mem spike on long prompts.

priya: noted — enabling fallback to matmul-compat variant, and thermal watch. also adding kv-cache warmup probe.

marie: release notes draft: "matmul-slim v3: quant kernel micro-ops reduced, ~15-25% CPU/GPU p99 improvement on short-context workloads; added compat fallback path." anyone want to tweak wording?

alex: that reads fine. add a note that canary may show transient latency regressions for very long sequences.

priya: deploybot command I'm going to run:
```
/deploy engine-quant:matmul-slim:v3 --canary 2 --stages 10,100 --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --quiet-window 00:30-03:00UTC
```
(ops-bot will pin v2 if rollback triggered)

deploy-bot: @priya received. scheduling deploy at 00:35 UTC. will post canary health after each stage.

zach: rollback criteria proposal: 1) error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m, 2) latency p99 increase >8% vs baseline for 10m, 3) memory OOM or thermal > threshold. if any triggered, auto-pin previous runtime and stop rollout.

marie: I can own release-note publish + changelog entry after final sweep. will coordinate with docs.

alex: add a manual gate for the 10%->100% jump (need two approvals: eng lead + oncall). safer to stop if signals noisy.

priya: agreed — adding manual approval hook between stage 2 and 3. ops-bot, please create the approval ticket.

ops-bot: created ticket #ENG-8345 for manual approval; assignees: alex, oncall. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-8345

deploy-bot: canary started in us-east-1 (2%). collecting metrics: throughput 480rps, p99 45ms, errors 0.03%. will report in 5m.

zach: baseline p99=42ms, so +7% — within threshold but keep eye on trend.

priya: if all good at 5m and no thermal events, move to 10% eu-west-1. otherwise we'll pin and abort.

marie: pinging docs to prep the note for release channel. :spiral_note_pad: 

deploy-bot: 5m canary report: p99=46ms (+9% vs baseline), errors 0.04%, thermal stable. sticking to Alex/Oncall approval before next stage as discussed.

alex: I want one more 5m sample. holding.

zach: logging detailed perf trace to https://dash.redwood.ai/run/8345 - see context length 8k showing spikes at token 512.

priya: will abort to pin v2 if next sample shows continued >8% p99. thanks all."
